nodes.label: Value, Bespoke Care & On-Page SEO Initiative
nodes.rationale: The site is SEO-mature (canonical/hreflang/OG, schema, sitemap, llms.txt all done); the next tier of improvement is conversion plus a short list of genuine on-page SEO gaps. With no usable GA4/Search Console/enquiry data, changes must be best-practice-driven rather than A/B-tested. The owner's thesis -- price value is real but buried in prose, and bespoke personal care is described in paragraphs but never dramatised -- is packaged as two reusable, site-wide components (a value block and a care strip) across all four service lines, deliberately avoiding a headcount ('150+ musicians') trust signal in favour of the Artistic Director's Oxford credential, consistent with the positioning correction made in the Competitive Capture programme.

edges.source_location: Both initiatives modify services.html's structure and content in sequence
